resolved: Terminal outcome is an explicit defeat, despite loading at approximately 707 seconds; final results are visible at 710 seconds.
Final knockout awards two points; results display owner 1 and opponent 3 circles.
Indeedee Psychic costs two Psychic, not two Colorless. Water attachments cannot power it; displayed 120 is prospective damage, not an executed attack.
Turn 17 rescue is actually performed: Water to 20-HP benched Indeedee, retreat it Active, two Watch Over, Lucky Ice Pop, Irida and Shore.
The recording contains no Wailord evolution or Wailord attack; both Wailmer are gone before Copycat supplies the late whale cards.
